overviewFeedback.macroHint: SPY is the distance from its 200-session moving average. Missing feeds stay blank; no market regime is inferred.
overviewFeedback.portfolioHint: Area = position weight · green/red = latest daily close change · grey = missing change. Snapshot weights and price dates can differ.
overviewFeedback.pulseHint: Last 7 days · first detected · all radar views
overviewFeedback.pulseLegend: Each dot is an event, repeated for each linked symbol. Larger dots = higher radar score (0–1), not a return forecast. Dashed purple = rumor; amber = macro; blue = other events. Click a dot to read its sources.
overviewFeedback.pulseScope: Showing {shown} of {total} events · latest 100 at most
overviewFeedback.funnelHint: News ingested in the last 30 days → distinct linked events → triaged events → events with any recorded signal. Each event counts once, regardless of its current signal status.
overviewFeedback.active: Latest active signals · all-time status counts above
overviewFeedback.strengthHint: Recorded signal strength (0–1), not probability of profit
